findings.title: Include required cursor:null in all result/artifact requests
findings.evidence: Packaged remote1.1 result/artifact request schema requires operation,result_id,cursor. Three literal dictionaries omit cursor; dynamic cross-principal security loop also omits it. Good result/export would fail400invalid_schema, and intended oldID/cross-principal403 result denials would instead fail schema validation.
findings.correction: Add cursor=None for every result_read/artifact_read request, including dynamic security dictionaries; retain exact declared send counts and full-producer/golden checks.

findings.title: Protect scheduler/listener acquisition and setup immediately
findings.evidence: setup returns an owned scheduler before the protected runtime-loop try. Credential/limits/listener preparation follows outside it. Inert fake Credential.provision MemoryError after successful fake setup exits with zero scheduler.close calls. Listener configuration failure similarly has an unprotected acquired listener interval.
findings.correction: Initialize ownership/bookkeeping before acquisition; enter try before acquiring scheduler, and conditionally attempt every acquired scheduler/listener/connection cleanup on setup and loop failures while preserving active original error.

findings.title: Always attempt owned handle closes and retain the first observer failure
findings.evidence: Observed close catches first fake poll OSError, then a later clock MemoryError escapes before process/thread/job CloseHandle attempts. All three owned identities remain uncleared; the later error masks the first.
findings.correction: Protect all observation/clock/accounting work and use unconditional finally with independent per-slot lookup/CloseHandle/bookkeeping attempts. Retain earliest actual error; observations remain false/unknown and no successor admission on unresolved identity.

findings.title: Preserve startup errors through independent joins and safe hook restoration
findings.evidence: Inert partial Thread.start OSError followed by join MemoryError raises the cleanup error and leaves the replacement close hook installed. Load join finally also aborts remaining joins if an earlier caller.join raises.
findings.correction: Track potentially started identities before start; independently attempt joins/is_alive inspections, retain original primary/first cleanup, and restore only own hook after observer settlement. Do not report successful cleanup or permit next epoch with a live/unobserved thread.
